description.value: A family-run general store perched on the Oyama Isthmus directly on the Okanagan Rail Trail, between Wood Lake and Kalamalka Lake — widely described as the trail's natural midpoint rest stop for cyclists riding between Kelowna and Vernon. Beyond groceries, liquor, and Canada Post services, it operates a rental hub offering European-designed e-bikes, paddleboards, and kayaks. Established in 2003 and sole-proprietor owned since 2015, it is a genuine community anchor that serves both locals and trail visitors.

address.value: Oyama Isthmus, Lake Country, BC (off Hwy 97 via Pelmewash Pkwy)

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully functional and rich with evidence for an active, family-run general store sitting directly on the Okanagan Rail Trail at the Oyama Isthmus. The site explicitly confirms groceries, ice, liquor, Canada Post, and e-bike/paddleboard/kayak rentals, and provides a phone number (250-548-3400) absent from the OSM record. No mention of bike parking infrastructure, water refill, washrooms, or other amenity details appears on the website, so those remain null per the absence-of-evidence rule.

OSM tag shop=convenience understates the business, which is a full general store with licensed liquor, Canada Post agency, and an e-bike/paddleboard rental operation — may warrant a richer OSM tagging review.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, active, publicly accessible business directly on the Okanagan Rail Trail with strong evidence of operation since 2003; highly relevant to touring cyclists as a grocery, liquor, and e-bike rental stop.
enrichment_extras.notes: The store also operates as 'Oyama E-Bike & Board' for its rental arm, formerly known as Sokal Rentals. Cyclists on the Okanagan Rail Trail pass directly in front of the store.
